newsitem.title: USA: Ferro shares up on restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Ferro shares up on restructuring.

text.p: Ferro Corp shares rose 2-3/4, or 8.76 percent, to 34-1/8 with 56,300 shares traded after the company announced it would close some 30 operating units during the next three years.
Ferro said that it would take a $100 million post-tax charge on the deal and that the charge before tax would be $153 million.

The net cash cost of the plan is $38 million and the specialty chemicals maker said that when complete the restructuring would improve operating profit by $30 million a year. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
